title: GCT report dataset, dataset schema 1
description: The JSON export of a GCT report dataset (gct report NAME --format json): one published data version, the evidence index, the restatement log and the gap report with GCT's exact words. Every object is closed and every key required; the identity, the filter echo and the label column depend on mode. Validate with any Draft 2020-12 validator; no network is needed.
